messages:
Renee C.: Running through the onboarding walkthrough and hitting noisy typechecker errors. The SDK's generated models leak Any in a few places and stream chunks are untyped dicts. Minimal example:\n```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = await client.chat.create(prompt=\"hello\")
# mypy: \"Item has type Any\" when doing resp.output[0].text

async for chunk in client.chat.stream(prompt=\"hi\"):
    # pyright: Property 'text' does not exist on type 'dict'
    print(chunk[\"text\"])```\n
Marco (sdk): Thanks Renee. We're aware the generator favours runtime speed over typing accuracy. Short-term fixes we can ship: tighten param typing (map number/integer/boolean/string to float/int/bool/str), emit Optional[...] for nullable fields, and add a small TypedDict for stream chunks with keys we know (text, role, finished).\n
Renee C.: That would already cut down the noise a lot. Our onboarding docs point at examples/, and new hires run pyright/mypy on the samples. If samples fail they get stuck.\n
Marco (sdk): Medium-term plan: generate .pyi stubs for the public client surface so strict typecheckers see precise signatures without forcing heavy runtime parsing. Also introduce a generic Response[T] wrapper and annotate non-streaming methods -> Response[Model]. For streaming, change AsyncIterator[Any] -> AsyncIterator[TypedChunk].\n
DevEx Team: Can we also get an examples/typed_chat.py and examples/typed_stream.py committed that are clean under both mypy and pyright? A CI job that typechecks examples would catch regressions early. Also document pydantic v1/v2 compatibility in the README.\n
Marco (sdk): Agreed. Implementation notes:\n- Add typed_responses: bool flag on Client to opt-out to raw dicts for perf-sensitive users. Default will be typed_responses=True but we'll add clear migration docs.\n- For streaming, the TypedDict conversion will be shallow to avoid perf regression (no full validation on each chunk).\n- Emit .pyi stubs and a small compatibility shim when pydantic_version < 2.\n
Renee C.: One more ask: map union/oneOf to Union[...] when safe and prefer Literal[...] for enum-like fields. That helps mypy/pyright give better completions in editors.\n
Marco (sdk): Good point. We'll update the generator to emit Union[...] for oneOf when schemas are disjoint, and use Literal for enum cases. We'll start with a 0.9.x patch that fixes param types and add full stubs + typed examples in 0.10.0-alpha.\n
types-bot: Created ticket SDK-TYP-453: \"python-sdk: .pyi stubs + TypedChunk + stricter param typings + examples CI\" assigned to @marco_sdk\n
DevEx Team: Please CC devex on the PR so we can update onboarding checklists once examples land. Small improvements here will reduce friction for dozens of new hires.\n
Marco (sdk): Will do. Drafting PR now with minimal generator template changes and an examples/typed_chat.py. Will follow up with the full .pyi generator and stream tests next week.
